paragraphs: Mentioned in Moed Katan 15a, reporting in the name of Rav Yosef. At 13b the statement is attributed to Rav Huna, son of Rav Pinchas; he is also mentioned in Eruvin 29b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The differing names identify alternative attributions of the statement, not a statement named in someone’s honor.

The William Davidson text has Rav Acha bar Pinchas in Rav Yosef’s name at Moed Katan 15a and Rav Huna son of Rav Pinchas in Rav Yosef’s name at 15b. Eruvin 29b fully names Rav Acha bar Pinchas. Hyman’s supplied 13b reference is retained rather than silently changed to 15b.
